newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil reverses trend, ends up on technicals.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil reverses trend, ends up on technicals.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market reversed earlier trend and ended firmer on speculative and technical buying after September hit resistance at 1,180. Earlier prices fell on lower soyoil prices. September next resistance is at 1,200 and support 1,180. Market expects June 1-20 exports from SGS (M) Sdn Bhd on Friday.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - The market saw slightly higher as sellers were reserved. Activity was seen among CPOs.
